infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Forkbell connects to a heart-rate sensor you choose (a watch broadcasting heart rate, or a chest strap) to show your heart rate during rests.

plugins.cameraPermission: Forkbell uses the camera to scan food barcodes, and to measure the food on your plate with LiDAR.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Forkbell reads your steps, activity, resting heart rate and weight to show your progress.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Forkbell saves your daily calories, macros and workouts to Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: Forkbell lets you pick a meal photo for Bell to estimate.
plugins.cameraPermission: Forkbell uses the camera to scan barcodes and photograph meals for Bell.
plugins.microphonePermission: Forkbell uses the microphone so you can talk to Bell instead of typing.
Forkbell uses the microphone so you can talk to Bell instead of typing.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Forkbell turns what you say to Bell into text. On iPhone this happens on the device when it can.
